text:
Harper (CS): quick capture from today's "feedback concierge" batch — pattern across 6 onboarding calls: (1) customers want a sharable export of feature asks (CSV/Sheets), (2) clearer per-route spend labels (human-friendly), (3) a manual embeddings re-run / reindex endpoint. also one big ask: an MRR-impact flag so AMs can sort asks by potential revenue at risk.
Luis (AM): +1 on MRR flag. two accounts mentioned pausing next phase if bills keep spiking. renewal windows: TOPIA-9 (18d), ORION-2 (60d). marking TOPIA-9 as high churn risk.
Noor (PM): thanks. proposal: ship CSV export + MRR-impact field as quick win (low lift), surface per-route top-3 consumers in a banner for trials, and treat reindex endpoint as a safety / gated feature. agree we should include example customer quotes in tickets.
Harper (CS): sample verbatim quotes to paste: "Our search quality dropped after the new model and re-embedding is taking forever — we need a button", "We had no idea our test routing was spending tokens until the bill hit  we need readable labels and export so product can triage."
Kai (SRE): rough engineering view: CSV export + backend job + UI link ~1.5 dev days. per-route human labels + daily aggregator ~7 dev days (depends on existing rollup infra). reindex API + safety (rate limits + auth) ~6-8 dev days. we also need telemetry: `route.display_name`, `route.token_usage.daily`, `embed.version`, and an `embed.reindex.requested_by` flag.
Harper (CS): suggested triage scoring for the concierge: `score = (mrr_impact * 5) + (renewal_urgency * 3) + (reproducibility * 2)` where mrr_impact: Low/Med/High -> 1/3/5, renewal_urgency days_to_renew buckets -> <=30:5, <=90:3, >90:1, reproducibility (how easy to reproduce) 1-5. i'll run this over the batch and surface top 10.
Noor (PM): sounds good. can CS include an `acceptance_criteria` line for each ask? e.g., for CSV export: headers, sample rows, and a link to where PM expects the file.
Harper (CS): will do. here's a quick sample CSV row I'll attach to tickets: `account_id,account_name,tier,renewal_date,mrr_impact,ask,quote,severity` -> `TOPIA-9,Topia Inc,Enterprise,2024-07-15,High,"Per-route breakdown export","We had no idea which route ate 40% of our credits",5`.
feedback-bot: created ticket CS-99001 "Feature-asks export + mrr flag" and CS-99002 "Per-route human labels (banner experiment)". linked CS-99003 "Embeddings reindex API". CS-99001 assigned -> @Noor, CS-99003 -> @Kai.
Luis (AM): added account IDs and renewal notes to CS-99001 (TOPIA-9, ORION-2). i'll prioritize outreach for any item with score>=18.
Kai (SRE): note on safety for reindex: we should enforce rate limits per-account, require an AM approval workflow for high-MRR customers, and log `embed.reindex.requested_by` for audit. will add to CS-99003 acceptance criteria.
Noor (PM): plan: slot CS-99001 into the next sprint; run the per-route banner as a 2-week experiment behind a flag; CS-99003 needs infra sync and gating, target after sprint. Harper: can you upload the scored CSV + verbatim quotes by EOD so I can prioritize?
Harper (CS): yes — I'll push the scored bundle (CSV + quotes + mrr estimates) to CS-99001 and ping the AMs. will include which asks are renewal-sensitive and a short outreach script: "We heard your concern about unexpected token spend  we're shipping a quick export and banner to help surface route usage. Can we set 20m to review and reduce churn risk?"
Luis (AM): I'll coordinate outreach for TOPIA-9 tomorrow and loop in Support if we need immediate mitigations.
Noor (PM): thanks everyone. next steps: CS uploads scored list -> PM finalizes acceptance criteria -> SRE scopes telemetry + reindex safety -> AM does targeted outreach for high-score items. :handshake:
